anchors.name: fresh-session-runs
anchors.find:
CREATE TABLE session_runs (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  user_message TEXT NOT NULL,
  final_assistant_message TEXT,
  files_changed TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  token_usage TEXT NOT NULL,
  started_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  last_message_timestamp INTEGER NOT NULL,
  finished_at INTEGER,
  aborted_at INTEGER,
  abort_reason TEXT,
  jsonl_read_offset INTEGER NOT NULL,
  jsonl_read_size INTEGER NOT NULL,
  resume_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);

CREATE INDEX idx_session_runs_session_id ON session_runs(session_id, id);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_session_runs_jsonl_range ON session_runs(session_id, jsonl_read_offset);
